name: W3C PROV-N
abstract: The PROV Notation (PROV-N): a human-readable, non-XML/non-JSON textual notation for the W3C PROV data model, primarily used in specifications and diagnostics. A profile of the W3C PROV Representation Base.

sources.title: OGC API - Processes - Part 5: Provenance (registers `text/provenance-notation` for PROV-N)
